text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I lost...
But, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I got a one-two finish
with Opera O-san!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha, precisely! With this watertight, flawless teamwork, we shall shut down the 'Golden Generation' completely!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. Um... Opera O-san,
how did I do?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Was I able to sparkle, even just a little?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
“Yes. But we cannot call it perfect just yet.
Let us gather more actual race experience
to polish our radiant formation, Doto.”

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes.
Then, um, next is...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'd like the Tenno Sho (Autumn), pleeease.
I want to sparkle even more there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume was watching the two of them from the stands.
I walked over to her side and spoke up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph, it's you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Didn't you think so after watching today's race?
That those two are finally 'complete.'"
choice_data_list: ...I was just thinking. You've really gotten strong.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. But reaching completion ain't all good things.
It just means you can't aim any higher.”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The power balance between the two... Any idiot can see it just by looking.
Opera O's peak is just a bit higher.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If she keeps running consecutive races like this, Doto will likely
be beaten by Opera O over and over again
by the narrowest of margins.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And that ain't all, either...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —It's a wonderful day today, isn't it, Spe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Grass-chan!
Your race was really amazing, too.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Indeed. With the younger generation of Umamusume working so hard, perhaps it's too early for me to retire.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let us test our mettle against one another.
—At the year-end Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I must hone both mind and body to perfection—and meet them with a sharpness that puts even legendary blades to shame.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-You're kinda scaring me, Grass-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“You're right, though! Doto-san
and Opera O-san are amazing,
but we're gonna be even more amazing!”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "There're some crazy bastards out there. Limitless monsters whose stats you just can't read..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "That's precisely why that generation is called the 'Strongest.' Even I can't begin to fathom it."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
She's gonna suffer. From here on out, Doto will.
Clinging to the ceiling, struggling endlessly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "numerical ceiling" Air Shakur mentioned.
Does such a thing really exist?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My next race is the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
I need to investigate before then, and if it's true, prepare a countermeasure.
